build_start_session: start a new inference session on a video directory or path with optional session ID
add_prompt_video_frame: add text, point, or bounding box prompts to a specific frame in a video session
propagate_in_video: propagate added prompts forward and backward across all video frames to get segmentation outputs
remove_object_tracking: remove an object from tracking in an active video inference session
close_session_cleanup: close a video inference session and optionally run garbage collection
